title: RX 9060 XT hits 4.84 GHz record; Nvidia reportedly trims gaming GPU supply again
summary: A quiet Black Friday-eve news day. AMD and overclocker Bill Alverson pushed a Radeon RX 9060 XT to a new GPU clock world record of 4,837 MHz. On the rumor side, Nvidia is said to be cutting gaming GPU supply to board partners by another 20-30%, Blackwell Ultra server lead times are said to reach 40 weeks, and new Nova Lake details leaked. No new verified GPU, CPU or RAM price drops since yesterday.
takeaways: GPU prices are still far above MSRP and a reported supply cut could push them higher: don't wait for big Black Friday GPU drops.
Prebuilt PCs are where the real deals are this week (e.g. an RTX 5060 desktop for $749 at Walmart).
Nova Lake (Core Ultra 400) news is still leaks only; nothing official until CES.

items.headline: Radeon RX 9060 XT sets GPU clock world record: 4,837 MHz
items.detail: Overclocker Bill Alverson and AMD ran an RX 9060 XT at 4,837 MHz on liquid nitrogen (Micro Center, Austin), revealed by AMD's Jack Huynh with GPU-Z screenshots. The previous record was the same card at 4,769 MHz in February. (KitGuru calls the old record 4,789 MHz; February's reports say 4,769.)

items.headline: Nvidia reportedly cuts gaming GPU supply to partners by 20-30%
items.detail: Board partners were reportedly told of a 20-30% cut in GeForce supply for Q4, which would push prices up further. Earlier cuts of up to 20% were reported in January.

items.headline: Cheapest RTX 5070 in Japan up 44% in four months
items.detail: The lowest RTX 5070 listing in Japan reportedly rose from about $651 to $940; most models sell for over $1,100.

items.headline: Nova Lake: Core Ultra 9 4970K BFC reportedly boosts to 5.5 GHz
items.detail: A new leak gives the flagship Nova Lake-S chip with big cache (BFC, up to 144 MB) a 5.5 GHz turbo and lists more SKUs. The 28-core 4970K BFC first leaked in October (Tom's Hardware, TechPowerUp).

items.headline: TSMC filings point to a $22.6B 2nm fab in Texas
items.detail: Texas Comptroller filings reportedly describe a 2nm fab in Brazos County, built 2027-2031 with about 2,099 jobs. TSMC hasn't announced it, and other reports name different sites and amounts.

items.headline: Nvidia B300 lead times reportedly up to 40 weeks
items.detail: China Times, citing supply-chain sources: new B300 orders wait up to 40 weeks, GB300 14-26 weeks; it also says RTX 60 production could be delayed.

items.headline: Thermal Grizzly launches Delid-Heat-Mate and TG PadMate
items.detail: Delid-Heat-Mate (€19.90) for AM5, LGA 1700, LGA 1851 and LGA 1954, and the TG PadMate kit (€2.90) for replacing thermal pads on graphics cards and SSDs.

items.headline: RTX 5060 gaming PC for $749 at Walmart
items.detail: ABS Cyclone M Aqua with RTX 5060, Core i5-14400F, 16GB DDR4 (one stick) and 1TB SSD, down from $1,399.99.

items.headline: Adobe Acrobat Chrome extension blamed for heavy SSD writes
items.detail: A user measured over 300GB of writes in three days on an idle PC from the extension. One report so far.

trends.note: No newer standalone GPU prices than 24 Nov in the Black Friday trackers.
